title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
claim: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch — Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
why_good: A hands-on 'AI engineering from scratch' curriculum — valuable learning content, but it's education material, not a product.
value: Monetizes only as courses/cohorts/consulting; content businesses are real but different from a software startup.
risk: Crowded free-education space; tutorials get commoditized fast and rarely build a durable moat.
